resources.string: Journal storage
Upgrade to sealed storage
Upgrading to sealed storage
Starts once this device finishes syncing. Sealed storage encrypts your whole journal with your identity key, so only your devices can read it.
Sealing and uploading %1$d of %2$d items. Your journal keeps syncing as usual.
Checking the sealed copy against this device and the server before switching.
Sealed storage
Your whole journal is encrypted with your identity key, so only your devices can read it.
Switch back
Switch back to the previous storage
Available until %1$s, while the previous copy is kept.
Switching back
Downloading your sealed journal and returning it to the previous storage.
Previous storage
Your journal is back in the storage it used before the upgrade, and syncs the way it did.
Upgrade paused
%1$s Nothing changed, and your journal keeps syncing.
Enter recovery phrase
Switch back to the previous storage?
Your journal returns to the storage it used before the upgrade, which isn’t sealed. Changes made since the upgrade come with it, and your other devices switch back when they next sync.

Your cloud storage is full. Free up space, then try again.

The previous copy is no longer kept, so your journal can’t be switched back.

Personal space sync
Syncs accounts whose journals are stored in their sealed personal spaces.
Upgrade existing journals
Upgrades this account’s journal to sealed storage once this device has synced everything, on a server that offers the upgrade. Turns on personal space sync too.
